title: Derived exponent-one unit from the ordinary Cech cycle
statement: Let A,r,f and the derived categories of Spec(A) and A-modules be as in [def-pc-derived-category] and [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Define c_e by the explicit identity Hom stage class, the stage colimit injection and koszulCechDerivedComparison as in [lem-sc-koszul-open-hom-chain-representatives] and [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. Then H^0(R affineOpenSections(U)(u_0))(c_0) equals derivedOpenStructureUnit(A,U) from [lem-sc-derived-open-structure-sections-unit], for U=koszulOpen(A,r,f). No derived categories on over-opens or U are required.

source.place: Equation 36.9.4.1 and construction; Tag 08D1 ordinary cycle; Tag 08C2 resolution comparison

proof.text: Prove the private Cech augmentation/unit compatibility directly from principalCechDerivedComparison_exists. Choose the functorial K-injective resolution i:C to J and cancel the invertible derived resolution map, sections comparison on J and Cech augmentation on J. The defining resolution equation gives the Cech image of i. Naturality of the ordinary Cech augmentation and of the sections-to-derived unit gives that same image. Thus Q(augmentation_C) followed by the derived Cech comparison equals the sections-to-derived unit at C.

Apply koszulOpenHom_chain_class_naturality to the index-zero identity and its augmentation. This replaces derived augmentation of c_0 by the stage class of the augmentation chain map into the structure complex.

Naturality of homologyFunctorFactors moves the stage Hom-object iso, colimit injection and ordinary Cech comparison before the localization/homology iso. Apply koszulOpen_augmentation_cech_unit to replace the resulting ordinary Cech homology class with the Cech augmentation of openStructureUnitClass. Move this augmentation back through homologyFunctorFactors, combine the functor maps, and use the private augmentation/unit compatibility. The resulting expression is definitionally derivedOpenStructureUnit.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulOpen_exponent_one_unit
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] :
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    let G := (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor
    let c := fun e : ℕ ↦ H.map (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e))
        (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι
          (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
            (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e))) e))
          (koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e) e (𝟙 _)))
    H.map (G.map (koszulOpenUnit A r f 0)) (c 0) =
      derivedOpenStructureUnit A (koszulOpen A r f)
